rule: An AI vendor's host is written in ONE place: the shipped catalogue NPDevCli/ai-providers.json. Code reaches a vendor through the catalogue (npdev_ai_client, ExternalAiCatalogue), never through a URL of its own. Enforced by scripts/quality/check-no-hardcoded-ai-endpoints.py.
why: AIP-5 (5.3). Before AIP-1 the same vendors were hard-coded in eight places (adapter factories, Manager profiles, the bench, the review pack, a launcher with a leaked key); each drifted on its own and none honoured the spend guard or the key store.

allowedPaths.reason: the checker's own self-test plants and names vendor hosts
tests pin the wire shape against a known host
Python tests outside a tests/ folder (scripts/ai/bench/test_bench.py)
verbatim captures of `npdev ai` output, which lists the catalogue
prose that names a vendor is not a call
structured records of what happened, not code
